# AI-aktier får tæsk: Køb eller flygt?

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-10-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish podcast Store Penge (host Michael Bo Mortensen with geopolitical analyst Mikkel Rosenvold and investor Tobias Storm) argues that the recent sell-off in AI and memory-chip stocks is a buying opportunity. Their case rests on strong demand signals such as South Korean chip exports, ASML's order book running to 2029-30 and Micron's low multiple, even with Chinese competition risk. Tobias pitches UnitedHealth, DSV and Hermès as cash-generative, lower-P/E counterweights to AI exposure. The episode also covers geopolitical risk from Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia (a speculative Saudi ETF bet), a possible Bolsonaro win in Brazil's election, and a positive take on Parken Sport & Entertainment exploring strategic options for FC København.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 MU — Micron | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Mikkel (guest) calls the memory sell-off a buying opportunity; Micron trades at about 6x with guidance well above consensus. Tobias (guest) is also considering buying memory stocks.

#### Reasoning

Demand keeps rising: South Korean chip exports up 171% y/y, Elon Musk says RAM shortages run into 2028, and ASML has orders out to 2029-30. Micron guides 15-30% q/q growth against a 5% consensus at about 6x earnings. The sell-off came from Chinese competition news and the Broadcom CEO's 'casino' remark, which Mikkel reads as weak hands selling.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a Chinese memory maker scales advanced memory and breaks the oligopoly
- if memory prices fall in 2027-2028
- if hyperscalers report unprofitable cloud capacity sales

> *"Hvis du tager sådan en virksomhed som Micron, så er deres, de handler til kundet omkring seks gange deres multiple."*

---

### 🟢 000660 — SK Hynix | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Named among the memory stocks the guests see as a buying opportunity after the drop.

#### Reasoning

Same memory-cycle thesis as Micron: demand outstrips supply into 2028. The risk is that Chinese competitors erode its quasi-monopoly position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Chinese competition scales up
- if memory pricing breaks before 2028

> *"Og når I siger memory card stocks der, er vi så ude i sådan noget af SK Hynix, Micron, Sandisk, Samsung? Den slags? Ja, lige præcis."*

---

### 🟢 SNDK — Sandisk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Named among the memory stocks the guests see as a buying opportunity.

#### Reasoning

Memory-cycle thesis: strong AI-driven demand, and the dip is driven by sentiment. Tobias says it is approaching a buying opportunity.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Chinese competition scales up
- if memory pricing breaks

> *"jeg synes, at det nærmer sig noget, som jeg vil betegne som en opkøbsmulighed."*

---

### 🟠 005930 — Samsung | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Confirmed as one of the memory names included in the general buy-the-dip view.

#### Reasoning

Included only generically in the memory-stock opportunity; no company-specific discussion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory pricing breaks

---

### 🟡 IREN — IREN | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Mikkel owns it and holds until a rumoured Anthropic contract is confirmed ('buy the rumor, sell the news'). Of the names discussed, he is warmest on it.

#### Reasoning

The stock was punished for dilution and capex needs. A confirmed large Anthropic deal could add 15-20%; Mikkel plans to sell on the news. Tobias sold mining/neocloud names because Meta entering neocloud reduces their relevance.

#### Sell Triggers

- once the Anthropic contract is confirmed (sell the news)
- further dilution
- Meta or hyperscalers flooding the neocloud market

> *"Jeg har i stedet Iron, og holder den i hvert fald ind til, i hvert fald ind til, at vi får bekræftet en større kontrakt med Anthropic"*

---

### 🟠 CIFR — Cipher Mining | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Mikkel wants the price to fall further before buying, given dilution and heavy capex needs.

#### Reasoning

Dilution and large capital requirements weigh on the stock, so he waits for a lower entry. Meta's possible move into neocloud could also reduce demand for these players.

#### Sell Triggers

- continued dilution
- Meta entering neocloud compute sales

> *"Det gør jo også, at jeg vil nok gerne lidt længere hen på især Cypher, før jeg ser noget."*

---

### 🟢 UNH — UnitedHealth | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Tobias (guest) holds it privately as a defensive counterweight to AI; Mikkel agrees it is relatively cheap.

#### Reasoning

Hard-to-replace role in US health insurance, an improving medical cost ratio in the latest report, P/E low versus history, and demand unaffected by inflation. AI can automate its heavy administration, lifting margins, with low disruption risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the cost ratio deteriorates again
- if regulatory changes hit US health insurance

> *"Lad os starte med United Health. Det er en af de virksomheder, som jeg synes kan være en god modvægt til AI- og techsektoren."*

---

### 🟢 DSV — DSV | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Tobias recently bought it as a contrarian pick after a heavy fall caused by the DB Schenker integration problems.

#### Reasoning

Strong acquisition track record and an asset-light logistics model that has historically been very profitable. The DB Schenker integration has hurt key metrics and delayed synergies, but Tobias expects a turnaround over a few years. The host calls it a contrarian bet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if DB Schenker synergies fail to materialise
- if integration costs keep eroding margins

> *"det er også en aktie, som jeg først har købt op i her for ganske nylig."*

---

### 🟢 RMS — Hermès | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Tobias sees it as uncorrelated with AI, down about 40% on weak China demand, with an irreplaceable brand. Mikkel is positive long-term but wary of trade-war volatility.

#### Reasoning

Top-end luxury brand (Birkin) with pricing power, a de-rated P/E and price, and an expected recovery in Chinese demand. Mikkel warns that China may retaliate against EU EV tariffs by targeting French luxury goods, adding short-term volatility, though luxury can usually absorb tariffs.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the EU-China trade war escalates to luxury goods
- if Chinese consumer demand fails to recover

> *"Det er fordi, at det er igen en virksomhed, som der korrelerer jo ganske anderledes end AI og tech-aktier."*

---

### 🟢 PARKEN — Parken Sport & Entertainment | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Mikkel reads the strategic review of FC København as a sign of a likely takeover bid; the shares reacted positively and he calls it maybe an okay buying opportunity.

#### Reasoning

The announcement implies serious buyer interest. A richer owner could invest around USD 1bn in the stadium and training facilities. Parken is well run (Lalandia, football) and Copenhagen is hot as a tourist destination. The view is speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if no concrete bid materialises
- if the strategic review ends without a transaction

> *"hvis man tror lidt på den her, så er det da en okay opkøbsmulighed i parken, måske."*

---
